query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN implementationStatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN implementationStatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*), 0) as percentage
FROM criticalityMatrix
WHERE processId = 1290002;
